definitions.warm: one untimed public load, then repeated public loads; fresh stat/content and per-load resolution
definitions.first: one public load per fresh test process; fixture preparation and process startup excluded
definitions.filesystem: same absolute fixture paths before/after; no OS/page-cache purge; NOT disk-cold
definitions.order: before/after then after/before on successive samples; serial, no competing timed phases
definitions.counts: all config EvalSymlinks callback calls during one public load; exact user/project argument subsets and other=root/remaining calls
definitions.exclusions: fixture setup, compilation, process startup/cleanup, benchmark observer overhead, boot/model/network execution
definitions.profiles: typical=100 files/depth4/2 providers+2 plugins per source/2 JSON MCP; large-tree=10000/depth12/same config; large-config=10000/depth12/64 providers+128 plugins per source/96 JSON MCP
definitions.workspace_state: pre-approved through public Roots.ApproveWorkspacePrograms in separate prepare processes; supported api_key_env plus dummy .env keys; complete retained identities and zero diagnostics validated outside timing
